# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest published **SmartImage.Maui** release on [nuget.org](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SmartImage.Maui). Older versions are not patched.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do **not** open a public GitHub issue for security problems.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/MahdiKaseAtashin/Maui.SmartImage/security/advisories/new) so the maintainer can assess and ship a fix before disclosure.

Please include:

- Package version (`SmartImage.Maui`)
- Affected platforms (Android, iOS, Windows, Mac Catalyst)
- Steps to reproduce
- Impact (for example: cache poisoning, unexpected network fetch, local file disclosure)

You should hear back within 14 days. If a fix is warranted, it will ship as a patch release and be noted in [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md).
